$comment: X402-51 (v0.3.4 G, ADR-005) — built-in facilitator registry for the facilitator-fitness check. Maps known facilitator identity claims to probe endpoints. Each entry is matched against the merchant manifest's declared `extensions.bazaar.facilitator` field (case-insensitive). Unknown facilitators emit `facilitator_fitness: unknown` rather than attempting structural probing. The registry is data, not code — operators can override via `--facilitator-registry <path>` (deferred to v0.4+). New facilitators land as PRs adding entries here; ADR-005 § Risks #1 documents the maintenance pattern.
